verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent that takes natural-language requests to summarize, explain, edit and organize files, and handles multi-step read/search/write/organize tasks in a single request. It also offers natural-language search down to the timestamp or paragraph, and external assistants can drive it over a live hosted MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent reliably carries out natural-language commands (evidence is first-party docs plus an MCP liveness probe).
